title: Greedy strategy always converges to en-08 + en-05 only (2 tower types)
detail: All 4 greedy sessions built exactly the same tower composition: 2x en-08 (charge, ~450 DPS, ~2100 gold) + 3x en-05 (scatter, ~45 DPS, ~165 gold). No other tower types were ever selected by the greedy heuristic. This reveals: (1) en-08 is so dominant in DPS-per-gold that the greedy algorithm never picks anything else, (2) en-05 is the best cheap filler, (3) other towers (laser, freeze, electric, wl-02, en-04, hunter) are never cost-efficient enough to compete. The en-08 towers alone account for >90% of total DPS. This tower dominance issue means 6+ tower types are effectively unused in optimal play, reducing strategic depth.

suggested_fix.description: Rebalance tower cost-efficiency: (1) increase en-08 base cost or reduce its DPS scaling, (2) buff utility towers (freeze/electric) to have stronger CC effects, (3) add synergy bonuses for tower diversity. Consider that en-08 at ~2100 gold with 450 DPS = 0.21 DPS/gold, while other towers at ~200 gold with 40 DPS = 0.20 DPS/gold — the scaling on upgrades makes en-08 disproportionately efficient.
